## EVIDENCE

The implementation was verified with **14 automated tests** covering every failure mode:

| Test | What it verifies |
|---|---|
| `TestHappyPath/all_yes_commits` | All participants vote YES → global commit |
| `TestHappyPath/one_no_aborts` | One participant votes NO → global abort |
| `TestParticipantTimeout` | Slow participant (10s delay, 200ms timeout) → treated as NO → abort |
| `TestPrepareError` | Participant returns error from Prepare() → abort |
| `TestDuplicateSubmit` | Same txID submitted twice → error |
| `TestGetStateUnknown` | GetState on unknown txID → error |
| `TestCrashRecovery_CommitPhase` | WAL has `GLOBAL_COMMIT` without `END` → recovery re-sends commits |
| `TestCrashRecovery_AbortPhase` | WAL has `GLOBAL_ABORT` without `END` → recovery re-sends aborts |
| `TestCrashRecovery_BeginPhase` | WAL has only `BEGIN` → recovery aborts |
| `TestCrashRecovery_PreparePhase` | WAL has `BEGIN+PREPARE` → recovery aborts |
| `TestCrashRecovery_PrepareWithVotes` | WAL has `BEGIN+PREPARE+VOTE_YES` (partial) → recovery aborts |
| `TestCrashRecovery_CompletedTransaction` | WAL has `END` → recovery is a no-op |
| `TestIdempotentRecovery` | Recovering the same WAL twice is harmless |
| `TestNetworkPartitionRecovery` | WAL with `GLOBAL_COMMIT` no `END` → recovery sends commits to all |
| `TestConcurrentTransactions` | 10 simultaneous transactions complete without interference |

All tests pass with **87.6% statement coverage**, zero race conditions (`-race` clean), and clean `go vet`.
